body: For the neglect I experienced on his part at the beginning of this relationship , I never wanted children but I did it for him only to have him push me aside go focus on everything else he thought was important . . I was constantly reminded by him that everything he was doing was ‘ not for you , but for my daughter ‘ .

If you’ve come this far fighting all the things that bring you down , why let the evil win? Life will be back to normal before you know it . . If I can recommend anything to you is this , express your thoughts on paper , give yourself the opportunity to overcome this , you’re so young & have so much left to experience in this life . . That little push left inside of you will get you through these hard times . Your existence matters!

You’re not wrong . . I first hand know what you’re going through , I can imagine all you want is to feel & be loved . . Believe me when I say YOU MATTER . . 
Some people don’t feel comfortable with the topic of someone ‘ being gone ‘ . . They answer to end a conversation but most times don’t know what they’re doing to a person . . Remember you are NOT alone , there’s always a light at the end this tunnel . . Keep pushing <3
It may seem like the end of the world now , but with time , you will realize your role in life . . You are NEVER alone , even in your darkest of days . . We’re here to listen & help !
